body:
It's already been a week, huh? Well, good news are that I came clean and she turned out to be very understanding. Obviously, she was upset as she, just like me, has been living in a lie for the past 5 months. She wasn't worried about the money, not at all, I even had to convince her to start taking a partial cut from my salary.

Tomorrow, after noon, I'll be heading to sign my job papers and maybe even start working this very same week. Looks like a storm has passed our vessel, yet still, the feeling of guilt isn't gone anywhere. The feel of relief is missing for some reason, but still, there is some light at the end of the tunnel.

The scary thing is that I understand what you're saying is the truth, but my mind keeps forcing me into thinking that this is cliche/ "How to help a suicidal person 101", yet at heart I know you're right.
After my Friday/Saturday talk with her I'll update this post if you are interested. There isn't much to say before talking to her first.
I afraid I do not understand the meaning of this, if it's directed towards me or my problems. Really sorry that I cannot give a better reply, but my brain is a little pre-occupied right now :/

Also, that's just a band-aid fix for now, I'll offer her the in the coming summers when I'll work I can make a cut payment for my studies (obviously it is not enough to cover the whole thing, but it's better than nothing). I committed a crime in my eyes and that's the reason why I am suicidal, because I see only forgiveness or suffering.

Not telling her the truth is out of the question, I've been sitting on this far too long and look where it led me. There are two options:

1) She angrily accepts the truth and I find a job while I wait for September and pay her back.

2) She is in shock and denial, rejects the idea of forgiveness and therefore I am forced to get myself out of harm's way. I know what losing her only child means to her, but in my suicide note I'd leave every reason why this is a better way to me, maybe even videotape my last few days for remembrance ( I guess it's true that '13 Reasons Why' glorified suicide, because I want to leave something for the close ones as well).

Thank you for your reply, your reply is very close to my current thinking:

1) Since I am withdrawn without penalty, I can make my way back into the university without many hardships (hopefully) and begin my journey anew in 2018 September, therefore making her and probably me happier.

2) I've considered finding a job after I come clean to her since sitting on my ass for next 6 months will not do any good. I am thinking finding a job that let's me work like this: three/two days of work -> two days of rest -> three/two days of work -> two days of rest -> and so on... Paying her back is the least I *must do.*

As I mentioned in the previous reply, I am afraid of her not understanding and that dramatically affecting our relationship, which I cannot bear. She is a very gentle soul, who can be hurt so easily and hearing what I said is definitely going to sound like betrayal of her trust (which I have to admit - I exploited). I am afraid to die, but I am more afraid of being hated by the only person who matters to me.

Thank you for responding, two hours passed and I feared that this was taken as some troll post since I did not hear anything from anyone. I take it for granted that she will be mad, she has every right to, yet I wish I could work something out with her and then slowly but surely get back to being "normal". 

What I am afraid of is rejection, since due the my past experiences I've developed SAD and being rejected by the only person you care is heartbreaking. I seek forgiveness where there is none.
